deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Open-source payments infrastructure for on-chain settlement through smart contracts
Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances
Integration with banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and APIs
Milestone-based disbursement through TRSC and PSSC treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Withdraw 3,961,538 ada to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal says Wirex will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano smart-contract settlement to banking rails, stablecoins, wallet interfaces, and Visa card spending.
The proposal says the work includes smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and a wallet and API ecosystem layer released as public goods.
The proposal asserts that Cardano currently lacks seamless rails for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.
The proposal claims Wirex has 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal claims the project will increase Cardano utility by unlocking new transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.
The budget allocates 3,846,153 ada to the Wirex work package and 115,385 ada to the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The proposal says funds will be administered through Intersect-managed Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with specified addresses, multisignature-style authorization roles, oversight committee participation, milestone-based disbursement, and a public dashboard.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex real-world payments initiative, with Intersect acting as submitter and administrator, and describes open-source payments infrastructure, card and banking integrations, NCL compliance, Hydra voting approval, smart-contract-based fund management, and oversight arrangements.
